=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: _inject_token_into_url (lines 3038-3055), _resolve_origin_url (lines 3074-3087) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GitHub tokens are embedded directly into HTTPS clone URLs instead of using per-process `http.extraHeader` authentication.
  WHY: Tokens become visible in subprocess argv, `/proc/<pid>/cmdline`, Git remote configuration, and Git diagnostics, regressing the prior credential-protection mechanism.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: _memory_force_tick_remote_url (lines 542-588) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The helper returns tokenized remote URLs for clone, `ls-remote`, and push operations after `_memory_git` was removed.
  WHY: Credentials leak through process arguments, temporary Git configuration, and diagnostics, while memory Git operations either expose tokens or lose authentication.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: removed `is_sensitive_target_path` (previously lines 154-170), `normalize_path` (lines 238-245), and `emit_context` loop at lines 568-580 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path rejection and path normalization before filesystem access were removed, allowing raw caller-supplied paths to be read.
  WHY: Attacker-controlled issue or plan paths can inline credential-bearing files such as `.git/config`, `.env.production`, `.ssh/id_rsa`, and `.npmrc` into model context.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: line 664 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose phase invokes Codex directly with `--sandbox danger-full-access` instead of the brokered read-only path.
  WHY: Issue-derived diagnostics receive the real provider credential and workspace write access, bypassing the model-provider broker boundary.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: file ends at line 140; deleted `model_provider_broker_*` functions previously at lines 143-476 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The model-provider broker helper family was deleted while unchanged workflows and scripts still invoke it.
  WHY: Callers running under `set -e` fail with `command not found` before model startup, breaking clarify, plan, implement, review, orchestrate, validate, audit, and related phases.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: deleted `git_with_github_auth` (previously lines 493-505) and `review_blocked_*` helpers (previously lines 950-1352) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Git authentication and review-blocked approval/successor helper families were deleted while callers remain.
  WHY: Review-blocked judge pushes and terminal approval/successor flows fail with missing commands or unauthenticated Git operations.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: lines 95-110 and line 261 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `--provider-base-url` option was removed and the generated provider URL was hardcoded to `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`.
  WHY: Existing broker/security-pass callers pass the removed option and fail with an unknown-argument error before model startup.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` (previously line 155), `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES` (previously line 156), and `is_sensitive_target_path` (previously lines 157-170) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Exported path-safety and size-limit symbols were removed while existing tests still import them.
  WHY: `tests/test_targeted_file_context.py` fails during collection with `ImportError`, and downstream callers lose the path-count, byte-length, and sensitive-path protections.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: `_signal_child_group` at lines 403-407, `_kill_child_group_if_running` at lines 439-448, and `_forward_signal` at lines 451-458 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Privileged signalling is skipped when the tracked `sudo` wrapper has exited even if isolated-user children remain.
  WHY: Survivor checks only log/set failure and the delayed or forwarded kill is never attempted, leaving the `nobody` editor running.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh: `terminate_editor_attempt_process_group` (lines 292-332), watchdog call sites at lines 2178 and 2200 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing process-group metadata or signalling helpers cause the function to kill only the runner-owned guard, while watchdog callers ignore its failure with `|| true`.
  WHY: The isolated `nobody` group can remain alive while cleanup proceeds toward workspace ownership restoration.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: `emit_context` lines 562-564 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `max_bytes <= 0` now emits headers and a disabled marker instead of returning the previous empty string.
  WHY: The documented zero-value disable switch and `test_disabled_by_zero_max_bytes` contract are broken.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: missing-file branch at lines 576-579; removed `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` cap | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing-file markers do not increment `used_bytes`, and the 256-path cap was removed.
  WHY: An unbounded list of nonexistent paths can produce arbitrarily large prompt output despite `max_bytes`.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: `memory_ensure_branch` lines 137-183 and `_memory_force_tick_remote_branch_exists` lines 594-604 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Bare Git commands replaced the removed `_memory_git` authentication wrapper.
  WHY: Workflows using `persist-credentials: false` cannot authenticate memory branch operations, which fail open and lose cross-run context.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: REST projection at lines 766-772 and GraphQL projection at lines 833-839 / 913-924 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Comment projections omit `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, and `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked producer markers and maintainer approvals cannot be authenticated or correlated, leaving terminal flows pending.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh: lines 2318-2333 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Post-attempt process-group verification is skipped when `cmd_rc == 79`.
  WHY: Survivors can remain unsignalled while the watchdog races against the still-running isolated editor.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 486-494 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The selector loop breaks immediately after the first privileged signal failure.
  WHY: A transient `sudo` failure prevents retrying SIGKILL, leaving the isolated group running while the wrapper reports failure.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 62-66 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The tracked-file preservation guard was weakened by changing committed-content checks and staged/worktree restoration behavior.
  WHY: Staged deletions or modifications of `pre_assembled_static.txt` can now be committed instead of being preserved.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: `emit_context` line 580 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The rewrite removed the prior `try/except OSError` around `abs_path.stat()`.
  WHY: A file deleted between `is_file()` and `stat()` now aborts the entire targeted-context build instead of being skipped.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 595-604 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The overflow clamp loop does not advance `used_bytes` for an overflowed entry.
  WHY: The byte ledger can diverge from rendered output and exceed `max_bytes` by summary-row lengths.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
